tagline: Search Hugging Face for GGUF models and download them straight into a models folder the server scans.
authNote: The server has no authentication in v1 — a download writes a file from the internet onto this machine. Keep the server on localhost.
shelvesHint: A small hand-maintained list of search terms. Clicking one runs the same honest Hugging Face search — nothing here is ranked, cached or endorsed.
offlineBody: The server could not reach huggingface.co (its search proxy returned an error). Your network or HF itself may be down — nothing is faked while it is away.
offlineManual: You can still add models manually: download a .gguf anywhere and drop it into one of the scanned folders, then scan it on the Models page.
emptyBody: Try a broader term — the search only returns repositories that contain .gguf files.
filesHint: Pick one file to download. The quant tag is guessed from the filename and can be wrong.
targetDirHint: Only folders the server already scans for models are allowed — anything else is rejected by the server (HTTP 403).
dlEmpty: No downloads yet — open a repository's files to start one.
dlRetryNote: v1 has no resume — retrying starts the file over from byte 0.
loadNowBody: {{filename}} finished downloading — load it into the server now?
loadNowNote: Uses the server's current default buffer and context (see Settings → Server). Loading a large model can take a while and cannot be cancelled.
resumeNa: Resume is not supported in v1 — a failed download restarts from the beginning
deleteNa: deleting downloaded files is intentionally not available (the server has no authentication)
detailOffline: Hugging Face is unreachable — cannot load details.
contextNaHint: Hugging Face does not publish a context length for this repository.
ramHint: Estimated from each quant's real file size on disk (about the weights held in RAM). Actual use varies with context length and settings.
noDescription: No description provided by Hugging Face.
perfNa: Strengths / weaknesses / performance: Hugging Face does not publish benchmarks, so none are shown here — nothing is estimated.
filesGroupHint: Cards group files by quant (one badge per quant). This panel lists every file, including each shard.
perFileNa: Download counts are per repository only — Hugging Face does not provide per-file counts.
shardNeedsAll: Download together — {{n}} parts make one model.
nonGgufNote: These are not models (e.g. README, imatrix) — the server only downloads .gguf files.
latestHint: Newest GGUF models by last update, straight from Hugging Face — not ranked or endorsed by us.
